_**Agent (copilot/gpt-4.1)**_

The error occurs because the script is not expanding the tilde (~) to your home directory, so it looks for a literal folder named ~/src/linkedown instead of /Users/warnes/src/linkedown.

**How to fix:**
- When prompted for the project directory, enter the full path: /Users/warnes/src/linkedown
- Or, update the script to expand ~ to $HOME (using something like eval or parameter expansion).

**Summary:**  
Always use the full absolute path (not ~) when prompted by install.sh, or update the script to handle ~ expansion. The directory must exist before running the script.
